Triage: lands in `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (the watch-hint scanner) and/or extracting pr-automation.yml's inline `Check Changeset` step into a script file the scanner can see ⇒ `domain:skills` (dispatch-gates family), type Bug, `pm:queue`.

Rationale: concrete derivation gap with a measured cost (one patch round on a live PR) and a mechanical fix direction consistent with the script's own "derived, never listed" design. Dedup checked: the runtime-discovered-population derivation gap (check:i18n), the self-test substring-pin finding, and the self-tests-not-in-CI finding are siblings in this lane, not twins — the skills seat may prefer to package them as one sweep.

Serial constraint for the skills seat: same file as the check:i18n derivation card — do not co-dispatch; whichever goes second must re-derive its premise on the merged ref.

Size/model suggestion: S–M. This card edits `scripts/pm/**`, not `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`, so the fable mandate does not attach unless the fix crosses into the skill text — if it does, the dispatching seat must upgrade the model per the standing rule.

Notes for the PM, outside the machine-read block:

- **Re-derivation against the actual diff** (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`) names **no** check family — this path is watched by nothing in its own source. The dispatch's gate list was derived for the `pr-automation.yml` surface that measurement showed did not need touching, so it is a strict superset; I ran all of it anyway and added nothing.
- **No findings filed.** I checked whether the same single-line `run:` blind spot exists in any other tool: it does not. The other `run:`-matching regexes in `scripts/` are consumer-block wiring assertions against known one-line literals, which fail in the correct direction if the workflow style changes. Notably `check-shard-attestation.mjs`'s own fixtures use `run: |`, confirming block scalars are the ordinary style here and dispatch-gates was the outlier.
- **One deliberate non-change worth your eye:** the parser stays hand-written rather than adopting the `yaml` package that other check scripts use. `dispatch-gates.mjs` imports only node builtins, so it runs in a fresh worktree before `pnpm install` — I relied on exactly that during this task (the red-test derivation ran before the worktree had `node_modules`). Adopting `yaml` would be more rigorous but would cost that property; flagging it rather than deciding it unilaterally.
- The `skip-changeset` label is applied (tooling-only PR, releases nothing) and read back as `["size/m","skip-changeset"]` — `size/m` was bot-applied and preserved in the union.
- CI status at hand-off: `in_progress` — reported at draft-PR time per the standing rule, not waited on.

**Review: ACCEPT** — reviewer of record: skills seat, session `session_018WuTtyckQa1VcXwgd52JpN`. PR #8465 reviewed in full (parser change + all 14 new self-test cases) against `origin/main`.

- **Both card hypotheses refuted by measurement** — the falsification is the deliverable working as designed: the enforcement was never inline (it is a real script that already names `.changeset` in its source), and the defect sits one layer earlier — discovery read only the `run:` line, so block-scalar bodies were invisible and **six** gate families were entirely undiscoverable, the one output shape the script's own contract forbids. The fix is confined to discovery (`runCommandTexts`), adds no list and no path table (the 裁决 constraint holds), and leaves matching untouched.
- **Evidence discipline**: red test first (live repro of the miss on current main); reverse verification with the direction predicted in writing before running — exactly the 7 predicted cases went red, restore byte-identical; self-test 47→61 including the over-match guard in both directions (a gate named only in prose is NOT discovered; a real command beside a comment still is) and the live-file end-to-end pin (`.changeset/` path → ADR-0087 gate via its own watch hints).
- **Premise honesty**: baseline self-test was 47, not the dispatched 28 — same-day churn correctly re-measured rather than trusted.
- **综合分析 (three axes)**: the gap cost a live PR a CI round (real pull); fixing discovery rather than adding a second source of path literals is the durable, no-workaround shape; and the guard against prose-invented families is precisely the AI-error class this tool exists to prevent.

**Landing**: normal queue path (`scripts/pm/**`, not a skills root). `skip-changeset` applies (PM tooling, releases nothing). The seat flips ready + arms auto-merge (SQUASH) once the gate jobs on the PR's **current head** `4dc5c8f` read `completed: success` — flip check armed; `in_progress` at hand-off was an honest reading.
